title.en: Fable 20 — The Crow and the Pitcher

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A thirsty crow looked for water.

sentences.ar: הוא מצא כד עם מעט מים.
sentences.en: He found a jug with a little water.

sentences.ar: המים היו נמוכים והמקור לא הגיע.
sentences.en: The water was low and his beak did not reach.

sentences.ar: הוא הביא אבנים קטנות והכניס אותן.
sentences.en: He brought small stones and put them in.
The water rose and he drank.
A good head is better than strength.
